name: SDN Public Query Flow
description: Sandboxed public query flow (gateway loop G.5, mount /api/v1/query). A $HTQ HttpRequest enters on the http-request trigger, foundation/http-route route_public_query parses it (POST = raw SELECT body {sql,params,format,limit,sort,profile,epoch,source} or bare SQL text; GET/HEAD = the queryable-surface listing), hostcap/flatsql-query sandbox_query composes the effective SQL IN-WASM (validated sort/limit wrapping, or a named epoch profile nearest|as_of|forward over the unified OMM view with default epoch=now) and issues the policy-mediated READ-ONLY storage.query_sandboxed hostcall. The ENGINE enforces the sandbox in-wasm: a SQLite authorizer restricted to the record tables / per-source shadow tables / unified views (control tables and sqlite_* are invisible), single-statement SELECT-only validation, a statement timeout, and row/byte caps that REJECT oversized results (host config gateway.query; defaults 5 s / 200K rows / 128 MiB). flatbuffer path: all-BLOB projections (e.g. SELECT _data ...) stream as aligned size-prefixed frames via a host body reference; projections answer 406. json path: full-record streams ride through foundation/omm-json (bare-array, schema-exact keys per hard rule json-schema-capitalization-rule); tabular projections are engine-assembled bare-array JSON whose keys are the SQL column names verbatim. Sandbox rejections map to honest statuses: validation 400, projection-as-flatbuffer 406, timeout/row-cap/byte-cap 422 (+machine-readable code in the body). foundation/http-respond assembles the final $HTR envelope (200/304/4xx/5xx) delivered to the host-model egress sink. Bridge linkage: the only host crossings are the declared storage_query hostcalls (and clock.now for default profile epochs).

externalInterfaces.description: Host FlatSQL engine-native query streaming (storage.flatsql_query_stream). Served by the Go node today; browser-side flatsql stream ops are not exposed by the SDK BrowserHost storage adapter (server-only until flatsql ships as an in-wasm component dependency).

acceptedTypeSets.description: Canonical WASM-served HTTP response envelope ($HTR, module-sdk schemas/HttpResponseAbi.fbs): STATUS, HEADERS (sorted, lower-cased names), BODY. The host streams it back verbatim.

outputPorts.description: Exactly one HTTP response envelope per invoke.
